Name: BroadcastAPI - A Custom TV Channel Framework
Author: Astraios911
Description:
[center]
[url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/c4H2V2KJ/Installation.png[/img][/url]﻿[/center]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
﻿
[center][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fTLp6p3J/Features.png[/img][/url][/center]

For Players: This mod does nothing on its own. It is a framework library required for other mods to function. You must install content packs that use this framework to see new channels.
For Modders: For full documentation and examples on how to create a channel, refer to the mod author's [url=https://github.com/Astraios-911/BroadcastAPI/tree/main]GitHub Documentation[/url].

﻿
[center][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Yq9ZJZ4v/Compatability.png[/img][/url]﻿[/center]

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer and split-screen.[/*]
[*]Works on Win/Linux/Mac.[/*]
[*]Works on mobile.[/*]
[/list]
